notes.zh: App 高斯模块默认原生全量查看，移除兼容切换和编辑入口；新增漫游、相机滑块与数值输入、项目书签及 JSON 导入导出。优化完整属性解析、分阶段进度、首次渲染预热和原生诊断。本版本需要覆盖安装完整 APK，不下采样。
notes.en: Gaussian projects open directly in the native full-data viewer. Add fly navigation, camera sliders/numbers, persistent project views and JSON import/export. Optimize attribute packing, staged loading, initial render warmup and diagnostics. Install the full APK; no sampling.
